steps.comment: The Neon Core is gated by the sequence lock: an early takeCore must be refused.
Solve the lock, then the core must open.
Final core: wait for the finale state, then the epilogue cutscene, skip it, then credits.
steps.eval: new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const iv = setInterval(() => { const st = __game.levels.state; if (st === 'finale' || Date.now() - t0 > 240000) { clearInterval(iv); resolve('state=' + st); } }, 400); })

new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const iv = setInterval(() => { const m = __game.mode(); if (m === 'cutscene' || Date.now() - t0 > 300000) { clearInterval(iv); resolve('mode=' + m); } }, 400); })

new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const iv = setInterval(() => { const m = __game.mode(); if (m === 'credits' || m === 'won' || Date.now() - t0 > 60000) { clearInterval(iv); resolve('mode=' + m); } }, 500); })

steps.comment: Credits roll for ~26.5 s wall-clock, then the win screen appears.
steps.eval: new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const iv = setInterval(() => { if (__game.mode() === 'won' || Date.now() - t0 > 90000) { clearInterval(iv); resolve('mode=' + __game.mode()); } }, 500); })
